expected_metric: Attributable completed purchases from checkout sessions after guarantee statement is added
hypothesis: Adding a visible money-back guarantee to a cold offer checkout page is one of the highest-leverage, lowest-cost conversion levers available — measured lift ranges from 26% to 100% depending on guarantee duration, with refund rate increasing only marginally (3%). A guarantee statement on the Nebula checkout pre-page should be tested before any pricing or copy restructure.
observed_problem: Nebula has 19 checkout starts and 0 completed purchases — 100% abandonment on a $97 cold offer with no visible guarantee. CRO case studies show first-time buyers at unfamiliar brands require risk removal before committing.
smallest_safe_change: Add a visible '30-day money-back if not satisfied' text line to the pre-checkout landing page and the checkout header — a copy-only change requiring no code; measure checkout-to-purchase rate over the next 10 sessions.
stop_condition: Revert guarantee language if checkout completion rate does not improve after 10 sessions
validation_window: 10 checkout sessions or 14 days after guarantee copy is visible
why_nebula: Nebula's 19 checkout starts with 0 purchases is a first-time-buyer trust failure. A money-back guarantee directly addresses the risk calculus that blocks cold buyers at $97. This is the correct intervention before diagnosing price, copy, or audience.
